v0.4.1 dropped the sequence alias of pipe
v0.4.1 deleted R.constant = R.K = R.always: the constant alias of always is gone
v0.4.1 deleted R.constant = R.K = R.always: the K alias of always (since v0.3.0) is gone
v0.4.1 dropped the distributeTo alias of fork (added in v0.3.0)
v0.4.1 dropped the drop alias of skip
v0.4.1 renamed all to its alias every (R.every = curry2(every)); R.all is gone
v0.4.1 renamed any to its alias some (R.some = curry2(some)); R.any is gone
v0.4.1 dropped nth, an alias of prop since v0.3.0 (R.nth = R.get = R.prop became R.get = R.prop)

v0.4.1 dropped the flattenShallow alias of unnest (added in v0.3.0)
v0.4.1 removed all, which every aliased; every is now the loop itself, and the revealed body is the forall that all had, same results
v0.4.1 removed any, which some aliased; some is now the loop itself, and the revealed body is the exists that any had, same results

v0.4.1 makes foldr the alias of reduceRight: the revealed body now calls reduceRight, same ensures and results
v0.4.1 defines R.reduce.idx and sets R.foldl.idx = R.reduce.idx: reduceIdx's revealed body now carries the indexed fold, same results
v0.4.1 makes foldl.idx the alias of reduce.idx: the revealed body now calls reduceIdx, same ensures and results
v0.4.1 defines R.reduceRight.idx and sets R.foldr.idx = R.reduceRight.idx: reduceRightIdx's revealed body now carries the indexed fold, same results
v0.4.1 makes foldr.idx the alias of reduceRight.idx: the revealed body now calls reduceRightIdx, same ensures and results
